highlights.title: Overview
highlights.value:
The University of Sydney is one of Australia’s most prestigious and research-intensive universities, consistently ranked among the top institutions. It’s ranked 1st in Australia and among the top global universities in major world rankings.

It offers a wide range of undergraduate and postgraduate courses across Arts and Social Sciences, Business, Law, Science, Engineering, Medicine and Health, Architecture and Design, and Information Technology.

highlights.title: Student life
highlights.value: You’ll be part of a lively campus with over 200 student-run clubs and societies. You’ll also get many support services like wellbeing, health, academic guidance and inclusion, ensuring you’re supported throughout your time on campus.

highlights.title: Accommodation
highlights.value:
The university offers 3 different accommodation options. You can choose from university-managed residences, residential colleges with fully furnished rooms and meals, and off-campus options, including homestay and private shared housing.

If you’re looking for budget-friendly accommodation options outside the campus, feel free to download our app and check out the Stays feature!

highlights.title: Facilities
highlights.value:
Library
The university has an extensive library system with vast physical and digital collections alongside study spaces.

Sports
On campus, Sydney Uni Sport & Fitness provides you with sporting facilities, fitness classes, competitive clubs and recreation programmes.

Laboratory
You’ll find specialised laboratories and research facilities in domains like science, engineering, health, and design.

Cafeteria
You’ll find many different dining options on campus, around the Wentworth Building, which is the university’s main dining hub.
